Title: Starry Night Platter
Body (HTML):
A large one-of-a-kind round platter with a deep navy rim. From a dark eye in the centre, rings of gold and peacock teal spread outward in hundreds of tiny cells, flecked with violet, like a night sky swirling with stars.

Beautiful on a table or a stand, or as a centrepiece with a candle in glass or a bowl of ornaments.

Wipe clean; not for the dishwasher, and not for hot dishes.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Abalone Ripple Platter
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind round platter with a gently scalloped edge. Rings of teal, bronze and pearly white ripple out from the centre like a stone dropped into a tide pool, and right in the middle sits a little cluster of real abalone shell, shimmering green, blue and pink.

Wipe clean; not for the dishwasher, and not for hot dishes.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Twilight Anemone Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind shallow bowl with a scalloped edge, in deep cobalt blue. From a soft pink glow in the centre, hundreds of little pink and coral cells open outward like the tentacles of a sea anemone, fading back into blue at the rim.

Lovely for fruit, keys, or as a catch-all by the door.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Labradorite Tray
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind round tray with a scalloped edge and two gold handles. It's poured in teal, violet, copper and pearl in a crackled pattern that looks just like labradorite stone, and it flashes different colours as you move past it.

Use it for serving, as a vanity tray for perfume and jewellery, or on a coffee table to corral candles and remotes.

Wipe clean; not for the dishwasher, and not for hot dishes.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Glacier Agate Tray
Body (HTML):
A large one-of-a-kind tray poured to look like a slice of blue agate. Bands of ice blue and white sweep in towards a seam of crushed silver down the middle, like a crack in a glacier. Two brushed silver handles make it easy to carry.

A cool, calm piece for a coffee table, a vanity or a bar cart.

Wipe clean; not for the dishwasher, and not for hot dishes.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Flower Child Tray
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind oval tray swirled in hot pink, magenta, orange and turquoise alcohol inks, with real dried flowers and ferns set into it: red, orange and blue blooms scattered across like a summer meadow. The rim glows in rainbow colours when the light catches it.

It was made in two pours, so the flowers sit down in the colour rather than on top of it. A cheerful piece for a dresser, a vanity or a sunny windowsill.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Hidden Cove Tray
Body (HTML):
A small one-of-a-kind tray with a chocolate-brown wavy rim and a tiny beach inside it: real sand, white pebbles, little shells, a starfish, a big clam shell and tufts of green sea moss. Look closely and you'll find a little pearl hidden among the pebbles.

A sweet catch-all for rings and earrings, or a little piece of the seaside for a shelf.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Cinnamon Spark Tray
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind rounded triangle tray in warm copper and cinnamon red, the colour breaking into cells that spread out from a soft violet glow in the centre. The rim is packed with confetti glitter in every colour, so it sparkles from the side.

A handy size for jewellery, keys or a candle in glass.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Falling Leaves Bowl
Body (HTML):
A generous one-of-a-kind bowl in clear resin, layered all the way round with maple and oak leaves in red, orange and gold, as if someone gathered an armful on an October walk. Gold leaf flakes and shimmering ghost powder are scattered through it, and the rim is edged in glitter.

Getting every leaf to lie just so took patience, and the result glows when the light comes through it. A lovely autumn centrepiece, or a home for apples and gourds.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Turning Leaf Bowl
Body (HTML):
A thick, heavy one-of-a-kind bowl shaped like a curled leaf, in shimmering chartreuse green with hints of copper coming through, like a leaf just starting to turn. The veins and ruffled edges catch the light beautifully.

Solid enough to sit anywhere: a coffee table, a kitchen counter or a front hall.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Bronze Leaf Dish
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind trinket dish shaped like a long leaf, with a little curled stem. It's finished in burnished bronze and soft gold with hints of rust, and every vein is picked out in light.

Just right for rings, earrings or a few keys on a dresser.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Copper Moss Geode — Set of 5
Body (HTML):
A set of five coasters cut in the free-form outlines of agate slices. Each is poured in glittering copper, mossy green and sea-glass pebbles, with a heart of sparkling green crystals.

Five, not four, so there's a spare for the teapot.

Title: Blue Lace Agate — Set of 5
Body (HTML):
A set of five coasters cut in the free-form outlines of agate slices, in soft denim and sky blue laced with white, just like the real stone. Each one has a pale, frosty glow at its centre.

Five, not four, so there's a spare for the teapot.

Title: Meadow Lace Tealight Holder
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind rounded tealight holder in clear resin, packed with tiny cream ocean spray flowers that Janet grew in her own garden, dried, and set in by hand. It's like holding a little piece of a summer hedgerow.

With a light in the well, the flowers glow warm gold.

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Beach Treasure Tealight Holder
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind square tealight holder in clear sea-glass turquoise, filled with real seashells: a golden scallop, spiral snail shells, clams and little starfish, all resting on a bed of sand at the bottom.

It's the middle size of three sea-themed square holders, alongside Starfish Cove and the taller Seashell Lantern, and they look lovely as a group.

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Seashell Ring Tealight Holder
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind rounded tealight holder in clear sea green, with real seashells circling the well: spiral snail shells, pearly blue limpets, a pair of little starfish and shards of green shell. Look down into the well and you'll find a tiny pearl sitting in a shell at the bottom.

A sweet gift for a beach lover, or a bathroom shelf.

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Dryad Bust
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind head-and-shoulders figure, like a woodland spirit made of leaves. It's poured in soft leaf green and warm rust, with dark veins running over the shoulders and up the neck like the veins of a leaf.

Nothing is painted on. The veining formed by itself as the resin moved in the mould, so no two of these could ever come out the same.

A quiet, striking little sculpture for a bookshelf, a desk or a plant-filled windowsill.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!
